name: RevokeAccountPrivilegeZonal

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Note: This API supports only the cluster IDs of PolarDB on ENS clusters. For common clusters, use RevokeAccountPrivilege. You can call the DescribeDBClustersZonal operation to query the list of edge clusters
parameters.help_zh:
集群 ID。

注意：此 API 仅支持 ENS 边缘集群的集群 ID，普通集群请使用 RevokeAccountPrivilege。可通过 DescribeDBClustersZonal 查询边缘集群列表
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. You can specify multiple database names separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称。支持同时传入多个数据库，多个数据库名称之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token. The token must be unique across different requests and is case-sensitive. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
